Technical SEO.title: Google AI Overviews & AI Mode 0.9% Click-Through Rate, Opt Out Study Says
Technical SEO.summary: A new study finds the click-through rate from Google AI Overviews and AI Mode is approximately 0.9%. The study also found that opting out of appearing in Google's generative AI features correlates with a drop in clicks from the main web results as well.

Technical SEO.title: Google Adopts New AI Training Control
Technical SEO.summary: Google is adopting new AI training controls under consideration by the IETF that are intended to simplify and streamline how publishers and site owners manage AI training preferences. This is directly relevant to enterprise publishers managing bot-access policies.

Technical SEO.title: Microsoft Bing New AI Controls With AI Training From AI Search Grounding
Technical SEO.summary: Microsoft announced new Bing AI content controls offering simpler options for publishers to choose preferences around training, grounding, or both, while remaining eligible for Bing search results. The announcement came from a Principal Product Manager at Microsoft Bing.

Technical SEO.title: Google Search May Be Bringing Back 100 Search Results Parameter
Technical SEO.summary: Google may be restoring the num=100 parameter that allows viewing 100 search results per page, a feature it dropped in September 2025 to limit scraping by third-party tracking tools. The potential return is significant for enterprise SEO teams relying on bulk SERP data.

Technical SEO.title: Google's Gary Illyes: AI Made Bot Impersonation Worse
Technical SEO.summary: Google's Gary Illyes stated in a podcast interview that AI has made bot impersonation a more serious problem, with rogue bots increasingly pretending to be legitimate crawlers such as Googlebot. Enterprise sites with large crawl budgets and bot-filtering rules should take note.

Technical SEO.title: What Search Console Can Still Tell You When Indexing Data Lags
Technical SEO.summary: Search Console's Page Indexing report has experienced data lag before, and this piece outlines what each remaining available check can still reveal to SEOs while the data is delayed. Useful for enterprise teams managing large crawl and indexation workflows.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google's Q3 Earnings Call Casts Shadow Over Classic Search
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google's Q3 earnings call outlined a vision in which traditional search may no longer be the central product experience going forward. This has significant strategic implications for enterprise SEO teams planning organic investment.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Reddit CEO Says Google's AI Mode Does Not Drive Traffic
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Reddit's CEO attributed falling search referrals to Google's AI Overviews and AI Mode, and the company is now testing a login-only mode as a response to declining organic traffic. This signals a broader publisher reckoning with AI search's impact on referral volume.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: The AI Search Measurement Gap Brands Must Close In 2027 And Beyond
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece argues that brands need to measure whether AI surfaces recommend them to buyers, fix outdated source data, and translate AI shortlist visibility into metrics that demonstrate value to finance stakeholders. Directly actionable for enterprise GEO measurement strategy.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Big Brands Dominate AI Search But Leave Openings For Smaller Sites
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: New research identifies a potential weakness in large-brand AI search visibility that smaller or more specialized publishers may be able to exploit. Relevant for enterprise travel and cruise brands assessing their competitive position in AI-generated answers.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google Opens Connected Apps Preview For AI Mode & Gemini
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Google is allowing developers to apply to integrate their apps into AI Mode and the Gemini app, with a policy that bars misleading descriptions intended to influence app selection by AI. Enterprise brands with app ecosystems should monitor this integration pathway.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Discord To Put Public Chats On Pages Search Engines Can Show
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Discord's most public servers will gain dedicated web pages that may carry AI summaries and selected messages indexable by search engines. For brands with active Discord communities, this opens a new organic and AI-citation surface.

AI Search / GEO.title: Generative Pulse: Earned Media Still Drives More Than 84% of AI Citations
AI Search / GEO.summary: A Generative Pulse report states that earned media accounts for more than 84% of citations appearing in AI-generated answers. This is directly actionable data for enterprise GEO strategy, reinforcing the primacy of PR-driven and authoritative third-party coverage over owned content.

AI Search / GEO.title: Reddit Shares Plunge as Google's AI Search Squeezes Traffic
AI Search / GEO.summary: Reddit's shares fell sharply as Google's AI search features reduced referral traffic to the platform, according to Reuters reporting on weak user and revenue growth. The story illustrates at scale how AI Overviews and AI Mode are materially suppressing clicks to third-party sites.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Gemini Stopped Attaching UTM Parameters To Cited URLs
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google appears to have stopped appending UTM parameters to citation links within Gemini AI responses, reversing a behavior that began in early September and ended around September 28th. This directly affects how enterprise teams track referral traffic and measure GEO visibility.

AI Search / GEO.title: Search News Buzz Video Recap: Google Volatility X2, Spam Updates, AI Overviews Everywhere, Blending Ads & Organic, Google & Microsoft Earnings
AI Search / GEO.summary: This week's recap covers two separate Google Search volatility events, a spam update, the expansion of AI Overviews, the blending of ads with organic results, and earnings reports from both Google and Microsoft. A useful consolidated briefing on concurrent algorithm and product changes.

AI Search / GEO.title: AI Overviews: Google Makes Links More Visible
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google has made citation links within AI Overviews more visually prominent, a change with direct implications for click-through potential and GEO strategy. Enterprise SEOs optimizing for AI answer surfaces should factor this UI shift into visibility measurement.

AI Search / GEO.title: October 2026 Google Webmaster Report: Spam Update, Gemini 3.8, AI Contribution & Monopoly Rulings
AI Search / GEO.summary: The October 2026 Google Webmaster Report covers a spam update, the release of Gemini 3.8, developments around AI content contribution, and ongoing monopoly ruling implications. A useful monthly consolidated reference for enterprise SEO and GEO teams tracking Google's trajectory.
